leftEvidence.role: Confession, suffering, and the coming Kingdom
leftEvidence.title: The beloved-Son voice is first heard at the Jordan

points.label: Event action and claim
points.left: Jesus is baptized, heaven opens, and God’s Spirit descends like a dove.
points.right: After six days Jesus takes three disciples up a high mountain; his face shines, his clothes become white, and Moses and Elijah appear speaking with him.

points.label: Response and consequence
points.left: A heavenly voice identifies Jesus as the beloved Son and names divine pleasure.
points.right: Peter proposes three tents; a bright cloud overshadows them, the voice names the beloved Son and commands listening, and the frightened disciples finally see Jesus alone.

payload.posture: Matthew repeats beloved-Son and divine-pleasure language in two major events.

rightEvidence.title: Jesus is transfigured before Peter, James, and John

payload.tension: The mountain adds transformed appearance, three disciples, Moses, Elijah, cloud, and “listen to him.”
payload.title: The voice at river and mountain
